answer: The prism cap is enforced at intake and opal shows the per-origin counts. A datacenter or proxy pool thus cannot mint a farm in one epoch no matter how much capital it holds, because every participant consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. At most 5 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a terrace tag. That is 13 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
